metaDescription: Napoleon (Minuet) vaccine schedule with core ages in weeks. Set reminders so Napoleon (Minuet) boosters are not missed.

bodySections.heading: Why timing matters for this schedule
paragraphs: The Napoleon (Minuet) core series (FVRCP plus rabies per law) is plotted at 8, 12, 16, 16 weeks in the table above so a small kitten is covered as maternal antibodies fade.
At 5-9 lb (2.3-4 kg), Napoleon (Minuet) visit logistics matter as much as antigens: book the 16-week appointment before class, daycare, or boarding asks for proof.
Bring short-leg orthopedic stress and brachycephalic concerns from persian influence into the Napoleon (Minuet) exam-room conversation while you are already there for shots.
Rabies for a Napoleon (Minuet) still follows local statute, and when the clinic allows you can pair it with the ≥16-week core finish, then photograph the certificate into PetClues the same day.

bodySections.heading: If a dose is missed or delayed
paragraphs: If your Napoleon (Minuet) misses the dose scheduled near week 12, call the clinic the same day with product names — do not restart the Napoleon (Minuet) series from memory.
The danger for a delayed Napoleon (Minuet) is the gap, not the embarrassment, because panleukopenia pressure stays real for an under-vaccinated kitten even in clean-looking neighborhoods.
While waiting for the make-up FVRCP visit, skip high-traffic dog parks / unknown-cat intros and keep the Napoleon (Minuet) away from unvaccinated animals.
After catch-up, rewrite reminders for the next Napoleon (Minuet) due date (7, 3, and 1 day prior) so the same miss does not recur.

faqs.question: When does the Napoleon (Minuet) core vaccine series usually finish?
faqs.answer: This breed record completes core vaccines around 16 weeks of age, with rabies timed per local law. Your clinic may adjust intervals for the individual kitten.

faqs.question: What should I do if my Napoleon (Minuet) misses a booster?
faqs.answer: Contact your veterinarian for a catch-up plan instead of restarting or skipping ahead. Keep prior dates handy and limit high-risk exposure until the series is current again.

faqs.question: Where can I read Napoleon (Minuet) health context beyond vaccines?
faqs.answer: See the Napoleon (Minuet) adult health guide for breed predispositions such as short-leg orthopedic stress, then bring those notes to wellness and vaccine visits.
